title: Studio: the Validations tab holds the autosave on a served CEL verdict at the rule's own path, as the RLS arm does (#27482 layer 2 of 2)
body:
triage#1 · os-zhuang · session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U

Sub-issue of #27482 (layer 2 of 2: the console). Filed by triage on the `pm:retriage` request `6501208028` from `domain:ui#3`. ⛔ Not a claim.

Blocked-by: #27643 (lint emits `validations.N.condition`), on `main`.

## What is wrong

PR #27612 made a served CEL error at a `CelPredicateField`'s own verdict path hold the Permission matrix autosave (`draftVerdict.ts` `serverHoldAt` / `useServerHoldAt`, through `onLintChange`). The Validations tab has no such hold:

- `DataPillar` (`studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`) drops the served `_diagnostics`.
- `ConditionBuilder` carries no `verdictPath`.

So a rule the engine refuses (the nullable-compare rule) still reads "Valid CEL" and autosaves (PUT 200) until Publish refuses it.

## Expected

- `DataPillar` keeps the draft read's `_diagnostics`.
- `ConditionBuilder` and `ObjectValidationsPanel` carry the rule's `verdictPath`.
- The served error at that path holds the save through the existing `serverHoldAt` while the judged text stands. Editing the text releases it.
- Pinned like `PermissionMatrixEditor.serverVerdictHold-27482.test.tsx`.

## Constraints

- ⛔ No client copy of the publish rule (#26858).
- ⛔ No second hold mechanism. Reuse #27612's helpers.
- `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` is shared with in-flight PR #27617 (seat 3). Run the in-flight intersection check.
